change_log.value: Define strict service contracts (Pydantic schemas + interface boundaries) for facades, application services, and domain services; include anti-corruption layer rules and explicit input/output validation constraints.

Update facades and tool_router to enforce contract-driven invocation only, ensuring all external/API access flows exclusively through defined facades and aligns with frontend request/response expectations.

stories.title: Service Interface and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define strict service contracts (Pydantic schemas + interface boundaries) for facades, application services, and domain services; include anti-corruption layer rules and explicit input/output validation constraints.

stories.title: Core Service Refactor Implementation
stories.description: Refactor domain and shared services into isolated modules per ARCH-001, enforcing no cross-layer calls and eliminating implicit dependencies.

stories.title: Facade Layer Alignment and API Routing
stories.description: Update facades and tool_router to enforce contract-driven invocation only, ensuring all external/API access flows exclusively through defined facades and aligns with frontend request/response expectations.

stories.title: Integration Wiring and Dependency Validation
stories.description: Implement centralized service wiring in main.py with explicit dependency injection and lifecycle management per ARCH-001 composition model.

stories.title: Refactor Regression and Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Expand regression, unit, and integration tests to validate contract adherence, service isolation, and strict parity with pre-refactor E2E outputs.
